armor/heavy/chainMail.item: Sunken chain mail: a chain mail hauberk chestpiece of old bronze rings pulled up from a shipwreck, covered in sea-green verdigris patina, with a few clusters of barnacles and one big orange starfish clinging to the chest. The chain mail is painted as a simple, even surface of big round rings hinted at with a few strokes, smooth rounded shoulders and a simple round neckline. Shown like a close-up chestpiece: the upper torso only, from the collar down to the waist, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame and cropped only a little, no sleeves, no arms, no head, no legs. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish: no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, rings, stitches and texture only hinted at with a few strokes, no fine texture, no small details
armor/heavy/chainMail.palette: sea-green verdigris and dull bronze rings, pale barnacles, bright orange starfish; background of deep crimson and dark red strokes
armor/heavy/chainMail.notes: Second design; the silver starlight-mithril version looked ugly.

armor/heavy/plate.notes: Plain steel plate. The shipped icon is a generation that had a lion on the chest, plus a repaint that removed it (the lion, realistic or as gold relief, did not work).

repaint.instruction: Keep the plate cuirass exactly as it is (same steel plates, pauldrons, shape, outline, angle, background). Remove the lion and all gold decoration completely: the breastplate becomes plain, smooth, unadorned steel plate with the same rough brushwork and steel highlights as the rest of the armour, no emblem, no gold, no engraving.

armor/light/leather.item: Overgrown leather armour: a hardened brown leather cuirass with laced sides and a belt at the waist, reclaimed by the forest, with thick patches of bright green moss growing over the shoulders and a cluster of small glowing mushrooms sprouting from the moss. Shown like a close-up chestpiece: the upper torso only, from the collar down to the waist, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame and cropped only a little, no sleeves, no arms, no head, no legs. repaint.instruction: Keep everything exactly as it is (same leather cuirass, moss, outline, background). Change only the small pale mushrooms on the shoulder: make them a cluster of three solid, opaque toadstools with bright red caps and white stems, clearly part of the armour, not glowing, not see-through.

Keep the leather cuirass, moss and red toadstools exactly as they are (same shapes, colours, outline, position). Recolour only the whole background: fill the ENTIRE frame edge to edge with a burst of deep teal and cold slate blue brush strokes, no orange or brown left in the background.

armor/light/padded.item: Cloud-padded armour: a medieval quilted gambeson, a long padded cloth jacket with tall vertical quilted channels and a laced front, like a knight's arming doublet, NOT a modern puffer vest. Its stuffing is living cloud: soft white cloud billows out of the collar and the shoulder seams in big puffy wisps, and a few small clouds drift away from it. Shown like a close-up chestpiece: the upper torso only, from the collar down to the waist, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame and cropped only a little, no sleeves, no arms, no head, no legs. armor/light/padded.notes: Redone from scratch with one bold magical twist. Seed 7 with 'medieval gambeson, NOT a puffer vest'; the first try looked like a modern puffer vest.

armor/medium/chainShirt.item: Golden serpent chain shirt: a short chain shirt whose links are small gold snakes coiled into rings, each biting its own tail, painted as a simple, even surface of gold rings hinted at with a few strokes. One big, bold golden snake head rests at the collar, lying across the top of the chest with its body curling around the neckline. Smooth rounded shoulders, a simple round neckline. Shown like a close-up chestpiece: the upper torso only, from the collar down to the waist, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame and cropped only a little, no sleeves, no arms, no head, no legs. armor/medium/chainShirt.notes: Third design. The old whole-shirt icon was too detailed; the black widow hourglass version looked bad.

armor/medium/halfPlate.item: A half plate breastplate, close up, seen at a slight three-quarter angle: just the torso with a sculpted dark steel cuirass, a high gorget and layered pauldrons on both shoulders, edged in gold. Glowing arcane energy flows through engraved channels and seams in the metal like luminous veins, swirling across the chest, with tiny star-like sparks and faint constellation lines inside the glow. The glow stays inside the armor and does not spill out around it
armor/medium/halfPlate.palette: midnight navy steel with gold trim and glowing cyan-violet arcane light, burnt orange and molten gold background

armor/medium/scaleMail.item: A scale mail chestpiece, close up, seen at a slight three-quarter angle: just the torso, no sleeves, covered in rows of large, gleaming golden dragon scales that overlap like shingles, with broad scaled shoulder guards and dark red leather trim at the collar and edges
armor/medium/scaleMail.palette: gleaming gold dragon scales with dark red leather trim, deep emerald green and dark teal background

Shown like a close-up chestpiece: the upper torso only, from the collar down to the waist, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame and cropped only a little, no sleeves, no arms, no head, no legs. clothes/common.palette: warm undyed oatmeal linen, brown rope, purple lavender; background of deep forest green and moss green strokes
clothes/common.notes: Redone from scratch with one bold magical twist.

clothes/fine.item: Fine clothes: an elegant noble's long coat of deep midnight-black velvet with a high standing collar, silver clasps down the front, and a starry night sky embroidered across the chest and shoulders: scattered bright silver stars and a few thin silver lines joining them into constellations, the stars softly twinkling as if real. Shown like a close-up chestpiece: the upper torso only, from the collar down to the waist, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, filling the frame and cropped only a little, no sleeves, no arms, no head, no legs. clothes/fine.palette: deep midnight black and navy velvet, bright twinkling silver stars and clasps; background of warm gold and amber strokes
clothes/fine.notes: Second design; the wine-red peacock doublet was rejected.

clothes/royal.item: Royal clothes: the upper torso of a regal white military coat, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, from the high collar down to a dark navy sash at the waist: one large, ornate, sculpted gold pauldron on the near shoulder, gold trim along the collar and front edge, a few gold buttons on the chest. All the gold belongs to the coat itself; no loose gold strokes or spikes around it
clothes/royal.palette: brilliant white cloth and gleaming gold; background of vivid violet, cyan and fiery red-orange strokes
clothes/royal.notes: Reference zoom for the whole set: upper torso from collar to waist, filling the frame, cropped only a little.

melee/martial/battleaxe.item: Thunder battle axe: a one-handed bearded battle axe, the single wide blade of dark storm-grey steel, and its whole cutting edge is a thick, solid band of bright white-blue lightning that clings tightly to the edge, with a few bold, jagged zig-zag lightning bolts forking across the steel of the blade. Close crop: the axe head fills the upper part of the frame, the top of the dark wooden haft runs diagonally down to the lower left and off the edge. No loose bolts or sparks floating away from the blade. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish: no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/martial/battleaxe.palette: dark storm-grey steel, bright white and electric blue lightning edge, dark wood haft; background of burnt orange and rust red strokes
melee/martial/battleaxe.notes: Replaces the blood-moon double axe, which looked meh.

melee/martial/flail.item: A flail whose head is a heavy, blunt skull of dark cast iron, close crop: the iron skull is the focus and fills most of the frame, right side, seen at a slight three-quarter angle, with riveted seams, battered edges, a ring on top of its head and eye sockets glowing cold cyan. A short, thick dark wooden handle sits at the lower left corner, clearly separate from the skull with empty space between them, its top end capped in iron with a ring. One continuous chain of thick iron links runs from the handle's ring in a clean arc up to the ring on top of the skull, so the skull visibly hangs from the chain. Nothing else touches the skull
melee/martial/flail.palette: dark cast iron with cool steel highlights, cold cyan glowing eye sockets, dark wood; background of warm amber and burnt orange strokes

repaint.instruction: Keep the iron skull exactly as it is (same look, size, position, glowing cyan eyes and the ring on top of its head). Fix how the flail is assembled, which currently makes no sense: (1) remove the handle that runs behind the skull. Instead, a short, thick dark wooden handle sits at the lower left corner, pointing up toward the skull, clearly separate from the skull with empty space between them; its top end has an iron cap with a ring. (2) Redraw the chain as one continuous run of thick iron links that goes from the ring on the handle's cap, sagging in a clean curve through the empty space, up to the ring on top of the skull, so the skull visibly hangs from the chain. Nothing else touches the skull.

melee/martial/flail.notes: The shipped icon is this generation plus one repaint (see repaint) that fixed the chain and handle; the first generation put the handle behind the skull.

melee/martial/glaive.item: The head of a glaive and the top of its dark pole, diagonal from lower left to upper right: a long, slightly curved, single-edged steel blade rising out of an ornate golden socket shaped like a pair of swept-back feathered wings that flare out on both sides of the blade's base
melee/martial/glaive.palette: bright steel blade and gleaming gold wings; background of deep indigo and vivid violet strokes

melee/martial/greataxe.item: The head of a greataxe and the top of its thick haft, diagonal from lower left to upper right: one huge, squared, cleaver-like blade made of a single slab of pink-violet crystal with flat faceted planes and sharp straight corners, clamped into a heavy, blocky bronze mechanical mount with big bolts, and teal bands wrapped around the haft below it
melee/martial/greataxe.palette: luminous pink-violet crystal, dark bronze mount, teal accents; background of dark teal and deep emerald green strokes

melee/martial/greatsword.pose: the sword points down, the blade running toward the bottom border; the whole hilt, guard and pommel sit in the upper part of the frame
melee/martial/greatsword.notes: Older icon with no generate prompt on record. Recomposed point-down from the diagonal original so only the blade leaves the image, at the bottom.

melee/martial/lance.item: The tip of a lance and the top of its wooden shaft, diagonal from lower left to upper right: a long, wicked, needle-sharp steel spearhead with a raised ridge along its spine and cruel jagged barbs along both edges, mounted on a socket bound tightly with dark leather straps
melee/martial/lance.palette: cold bright steel with dark leather; background of blood orange and deep crimson strokes

melee/martial/longsword.item: A knight's longsword whose crossguard is a pair of spread raven wings in dark iron: two big, bold, solid wings with a few broad feather shapes sweeping out and slightly up to either side of the grip, a leather-wrapped grip and a pommel set with a round glowing gold gem. A broad, plain, bright steel blade with a bold pale edge. Composition: the sword points DOWN, tilted about 30 degrees from vertical, the hilt in the upper left part of the frame and the blade running down toward the lower right. The WHOLE hilt, both crossguard wing tips and the pommel are inside the image with clear background around them: nothing touches the top, left or right border. The ONLY part leaving the image is the lower blade, which runs off the BOTTOM border. The hilt is the hero: big and bold, the upper third of the frame. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish, NOT a toy: real weapon proportions, no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/martial/longsword.palette: dark iron wings with cool blue-grey highlights, glowing gold gem, bright white-silver blade, dark leather; background of deep royal blue and electric blue strokes
melee/martial/longsword.notes: Fourth design: the obsidian blade looked flat when recomposed point-down. Raven-wing crossguard, tilted point-down so only the blade leaves the image, at the bottom. A ram-horn crossguard (same prompt) also looked good but its blade ran off the bottom-right corner.

melee/martial/morningstar.item: The head of a golden morningstar and the top of its handle, diagonal: a round golden ball studded with a few long, sharp, pointed golden spikes all around it. The spiked head sits near the center of the frame, slightly up and to the right, with ALL of its spikes inside the frame; the handle runs from it toward the lower left corner and off the image border
melee/martial/morningstar.palette: gleaming gold; background of deep crimson and blood red strokes

melee/martial/pike.instruction: repaint the dark brown item as shiny, polished iron metal: cool blue-grey steel tones with bright white highlights along its edges and planes, so it clearly reads as metal and stands out from the orange background.
melee/martial/pike.notes: Repainted from the original pike.jpg because its outline was good. Note: the shape is a war hammer/pick, not a D&D pike (a long spear).

melee/martial/rapier.item: A rapier, the whole weapon shown diagonally from the lower left (pommel) to the upper right (tip), with clear empty space between the weapon and every image border: its swept basket hilt is grown from THICK, bold, smooth green rose stems with a few big thorns, curling around the grip as a guard, with one red rose blooming on the guard, and a long, slender, solid, bright steel blade running straight toward the upper right. The blade and the stems are bold enough to read clearly; no thin wispy tendrils, no loose leaves, nothing floating apart from the sword. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish, NOT a toy: real weapon proportions, no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/martial/rapier.palette: dark green rose stems, deep red rose, bright steel blade; background of warm gold and pale amber strokes
melee/martial/rapier.notes: Rose-hilt rapier. Seed 11 on a gold background with thick stems; earlier tries on violet lost the blade or thin stems in the cutout.

melee/martial/scimitar.item: A dark, shadowy scimitar, diagonal with the blade curving up to the upper right: the broad, curved crescent blade is made entirely of many black, shadowy spiders clinging tightly together, their thick, chunky legs locked into each other so the swarm forms the solid shape of a curved scimitar blade with a sharp tip. A few tiny glowing red eyes glint among them. The spider swarm grows out of a dark iron crossguard and a grip wrapped in bone-white cord with a dark pommel. The whole weapon is one bold, solid, compact silhouette with no loose spiders around it
melee/martial/scimitar.palette: shadowy black and deep violet spiders with tiny glowing red eyes, dark iron hilt, bone-white grip; background of acid green and pale sickly lime strokes
melee/martial/scimitar.notes: Wild take: the spiders blur into a dark mass at 40px. A rerun with five or six big spiders and a cleaner curve was suggested but not run yet.

melee/martial/shortsword.item: A magical shortsword, close crop on the hilt and blade, diagonal with the blade pointing to the upper right: where the blade meets the dark silver crossguard, a small black hole is socketed into the sword, a pitch-black sphere ringed by a thin, bright glowing ring of light. The blade is made of glowing electric blue magical energy that pours out of the black hole and is visibly warped by it: bent, twisted and swirling around the socket before straightening into a short, sharp-pointed blade. Dark wrapped grip and pommel below. The energy blade is bold, solid and opaque like the rest of the sword, with no loose glow or particles around it
melee/martial/shortsword.palette: glowing electric blue and white energy, pitch-black sphere, dark silver hilt; background of deep magenta and hot orange strokes
melee/martial/shortsword.notes: Generated diagonal, then recomposed point-down so only the blade leaves the image, at the bottom (replaces the earlier hand crop). A grounded steel-gladius redesign was worse.

recompose.pose: the sword points down, the blade running toward the bottom border; the whole hilt, guard and pommel sit in the upper part of the frame

melee/martial/trident.item: The head of a golden trident and the top of its golden shaft, diagonal with the prongs pointing to the upper right: the middle prong is a long, straight, sharp golden spike; the two outer prongs are shaped like a pair of golden feathered wings sweeping up and outward from the base and ending in sharp, pointed tips. A small glowing pale blue gem is set at the center where the three prongs meet
melee/martial/trident.palette: gleaming gold with a small pale blue gem; background of deep teal and turquoise strokes

melee/martial/warPick.instruction: The item is currently a flat black shadow silhouette. Keep its exact outline, but paint it as a real, textured war pick: (1) the long pointed pick spike that reaches to the upper left becomes a glowing magical crystal, faceted and translucent, luminous cyan with bright white highlights along its facets, set into the head with a dark iron collar; (2) the square hammer block on the right becomes textured dark iron with a few bolts, worn edges and cool steel highlights; (3) the handle becomes dark wood wrapped in leather straps. The crystal glow stays inside the crystal and does not spill out around it.
melee/martial/warPick.notes: Repainted from the original warPick.jpg (a flat shadow silhouette with a good outline).

melee/martial/whip.item: A whip whose lash is a giant scorpion's tail: a short dark leather-wrapped handle at the lower left, and from it a long, segmented lash of glossy black chitin plates curling through the frame in a big S curve, ending in a large curved scorpion stinger at the upper right. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish: no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, rings, stitches and texture only hinted at with a few strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/martial/whip.palette: glossy black and deep red chitin, dark leather; background of bright cyan and teal strokes
melee/martial/whip.notes: Redone from scratch with one bold magical twist.

melee/simple/club.instruction: (1) Keep the club's exact outline. Paint it in ONLY two materials: the whole head, the spikes, the bands and the two diamond inlays are dark forged iron with a few bold cool steel highlights; the handle is plain dark leather wrap. No wood, no brass, no gold. (2) VERY ROUGH, LOW DETAIL: paint it exactly as loosely as the original, with big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes. No wood grain, no fine texture, no small scratches, no rivets, no clean edges, no polished rendering. (3) Recolour the whole background so it contrasts strongly with the dark iron: fill the ENTIRE frame edge to edge with bright mint green and pale teal brush strokes, with NO maroon, purple or dark areas left in the background.
melee/simple/club.notes: Repainted from the original club.jpg. The original's maroon item on a maroon background broke the cutout; the mint background fixed it. A first try with wood and brass came out far too detailed, hence the explicit VERY ROUGH block.

melee/simple/dagger.item: A flame dagger, diagonal with the blade pointing to the upper right: the short blade is made entirely of fire, a solid, opaque blade-shaped flame with a sharp dagger point, hot white-yellow at its core and orange to red at its flickering edges, the flames following the dagger's shape instead of spreading out. It rises from a small dark iron crossguard over a dark leather-wrapped grip with an iron pommel. No loose flames, sparks or smoke around it
melee/simple/dagger.palette: white-yellow, orange and red fire, dark iron and leather; background of deep blue and indigo strokes

melee/simple/greatclub.item: Geode greatclub: a huge, heavy club carved from one thick, knotty dark oak branch, the head end swollen and split open, and bursting out of the split a big cluster of chunky, solid violet amethyst crystals, like a cracked geode. Close crop: the crystal-filled club head fills the upper right of the frame, the thick wooden shaft runs diagonally down to the lower left and off the edge. The crystals are opaque and solid, clearly part of the club, no glow spilling out, no floating shards. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish: no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/simple/greatclub.palette: dark brown oak, bright violet and lilac amethyst crystals; background of deep emerald and jade green strokes
melee/simple/greatclub.notes: Third design; the dragon-skull popsicle looked weird. Seed 42 left green background in the cutout.

melee/simple/handaxe.item: A small one-handed handaxe, a compact hatchet with a SHORT handle about as long as a forearm, the whole axe shown at a diagonal with the head at the upper right and filling most of the frame. The blade is a compact crescent of frosted ice: pale cyan ice crusted with a thick white frost rim along its edges, a few chunky jagged ice crystals growing from the back and the edge, the frost and crystals painted with a few rough strokes. The ice blade is fixed onto a short, polished steel metal handle with a small spike on top and a wrapped steel grip
melee/simple/handaxe.palette: frosted pale cyan ice with white frost, polished steel; background of deep violet and magenta strokes

melee/simple/javelin.instruction: (1) Keep the javelin's exact outline (the big leaf-shaped spearhead pointing to the upper right, the jagged collar and the shaft running to the lower left), but paint it as solid, polished GOLDEN METAL: clear flat planes of bright and dark gold with a few bold white-gold highlights along the edges, so it clearly reads as metal instead of loose paint. (2) Add a fire effect: a thin, tight, solid band of flames in white-yellow, orange and red that clings closely to the edges of the spearhead like a burning outline, with a few short tongues of flame; one compact shape with the javelin, no separate flame wisps, no sparks, no embers flying off. (3) Recolour the whole background so it contrasts with the gold and fire: fill the ENTIRE frame edge to edge with deep blue and dark teal brush strokes. The background strokes stay behind the javelin and its flames and never mix into them.
melee/simple/javelin.notes: Repainted from the original javelin.jpg. Loose flames (seed 42) left blue background strokes stuck to the cutout; the tight flame band fixed it.

melee/simple/lightHammer.item: A small one-handed blacksmith's hammer pulled straight from the forge, the whole compact hammer shown diagonally with the head at the upper right filling most of the frame: a simple, plain, slightly tapered head of dark hand-forged iron, its striking face and the front half of the head still glowing red-hot, fading from bright yellow-orange at the face through deep orange into dark cooled iron, with a few faint embers drifting off it. A short, plain, worn wooden handle runs down to the lower left. Grounded and realistic in shape, like a real forged tool, NOT cartoonish: no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes, no decorative bands. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/simple/lightHammer.palette: dark charcoal iron, red-hot glowing yellow-orange and deep orange heat, worn brown wood; background of deep teal and cold slate blue strokes
melee/simple/lightHammer.notes: Redone because the old icon (blocky steel head, copper bands, cyan rune, thick ink outlines) looked too comic-like. The prompt explicitly bans outlines and comic style.

melee/simple/mace.item: Lantern mace: a classic flanged mace of dark iron whose head is an open cage of six tall, straight flanges, and inside the cage burns a bright, solid blue-white flame, like a lantern. Close crop: the mace head fills the upper right of the frame, the short iron handle wrapped in dark leather runs diagonally down to the lower left and off the edge. The flame stays inside the cage, opaque and solid, no sparks, embers or smoke around it. Grounded and believable in shape, NOT cartoonish: no thick black ink outlines, no comic-book style, no runes. Painted VERY ROUGH and LOW DETAIL: big flat planes of colour blocked in with a few chunky dry-brush strokes, no fine texture, no small details
melee/simple/mace.palette: dark iron flanges, bright cyan and white flame, dark leather grip; background of warm crimson and blood orange strokes
melee/simple/mace.notes: Replaces the eyeball mace, which didn't fit the weapon.

melee/simple/quarterstaff.item: A golden quarterstaff topped with a statue of an eagle, close crop: the eagle statue is the focus and fills most of the upper part of the frame. A proud eagle of solid polished gold perches upright on the top end of the staff, seen in side profile facing right, wings folded tight against its body, sharp hooked beak, talons gripping a round gold knob on the staff's tip.
